description:
Cast Gemcutter Buccaneer by paying {3}{R}. When it enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
When the Treasure enters, Barret triggers, creating a 2/2 Rebel creature token which enters as a Pirate due to Maskwood Nexus.
When the Rebel enters, Gemcutter Buccaneer triggers, creating a tapped Treasure token that enters as an Equipment.
Repeat from step 2.
